Remark
[length-minimizers reparametrize a segment]

Source: petersen:page-0238 ↗ def:pet-ch5-segment 1. ch5:5.9.7For $c\in \Omega _{p,q}$ with $L(c)=|pq|$: (1) show $L(c|_{[a,b]})=|c(a)c(b)|$ for all $a,b\in [0,1]$; (2) show there is a segment $\sigma \in \Omega _{p,q}$ and monotone $\varphi :[0,1]\to [0,1]$ (not necessarily everywhere smooth) with $c=\sigma \circ \varphi $.
